'''Durrsk''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. A large debt was owed to him by [[Tyrnia Masak]]'s [[Tyrnia Masak's mother|mother]]. When she defaulted on it, Durrsk took her daughter instead. His [[Unidentified fighting master|fighting master]] trained the girl as a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]], in which she excelled. Durrsk later [[Death/Legends|killed]] Masak's mother one day in a fit of rage; at her next bout, Masak retaliated by killing the Quarren as well as his [[Unidentified Hutt spectator|Hutt guest]].

The Quarren's family later placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Masak.
